references.text: Describes how the fat from the peace offering is to be placed on the breast pieces and burned on the altar, which is the same sacrificial practice performed in Leviticus 9:20.
Gives instructions that the fat should be placed on the breast and presented before the Lord, after which the fat is to be burned on the altar.
Moses took all the fat that was on the internal organs and made it smoke on the altar, paralleling Aaron's action in 9:20.
Shows the same pattern where the fat is taken and placed together with the breast before being offered on the altar.
Describes how the fat from the sin offering is to be removed and burned on the altar of burnt offering.
Instruction to take the fat that covers the internal organs and burn it on the altar, the same practice as in Leviticus 9:20.
